schema.note: Exact tagged openapi.json bytes: 45 paths and 47 operations. Compared with 0.4.6, four RFQv1 paths and five operations are removed; no paths or operations are added. Unrelated v1 route families and RFQv2 remain.

releaseEvidence.note: Release owner verified the non-public immutable tag, engineer Secure Shell (SSH) signature, private prerelease and successful exact-source deployment on 2026-10-16. Public interface evidence is the frozen schema and live documentation. No software development kit (SDK), binary, package-registry or container-image artifact/digest/attestation is certified; the interface digest is not an implementation-image digest.

notices: Breaking RFQv1 retirement: canonical and version-first reads/writes return 404 without redirects. RFQv2 remains; unrelated v1 APIs are not retired. Legacy database rows, signed payloads and financial citations are retained without a replacement public history endpoint. Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) retirement does not cancel independent signed orders.

API 0.4.6 historically promised RFQv1. Its record and schema are not relabelled; the shared live service no longer satisfies that covered RFQv1 promise. Release publication does not erase historical availability failures or establish completed notices.

No database migration, row rewrite, contract change or signing-domain change is included. Existing role-less rollover signatures retain their payload hashes; the optional explicit role is signed when supplied. Deploy API support before role-bearing writers.

CLI (command-line interface) and MCP (Model Context Protocol) 0.7.0 readers can consume linked orders, but builders and requester-only rollover write checks need a separate update for the explicit cST flow. External client release/installation is not a core component requirement; actual compatibility remains a cut obligation.

The source merge is GitHub/web-flow-signed, not engineer-SSH-signed. The annotated tag is engineer-signed and GitHub-verified. Independent exact-version review is not established; no prior signing, review, notice or integration waiver is inherited.
The previous internal-policy metadata description is removed from this new schema; frozen historical schemas remain unchanged.
knownIssues: Required RFQv1 direct notices, posted/effective dates, usage assessment and consumer/history acceptance are not established by this component release. Whole-core integration, consumer adoption, production-equivalent database roles and interrupted-rollout/recovery proof remain open.

Exact-tree continuous integration passed build/schema checks, 630 tests with 2 skipped, and compiled native-order/RFQ HTTP smoke checks. Actual local version/schema and disposable-Postgres RFQ cutover smoke passed. Broader local runs encountered Podman socket/hooks; extra standalone orderbook/expiry checks did not complete and are not claimed green.

Native discovery availability and execution-confidence labels do not establish finality or execution permission. Stored rollover status retains legacy semantics; effectiveStatus adds a projection and an intersecting filter. No whole-set accounting, settlement or economic acceptance is inferred from local fixtures.

Build commitments were refreshed in indexing-evidence.json only after this proof. This is event-layout correspondence, not independent implementation provenance, handler-accounting review, image attestation or worker-rollout acceptance.
